scenarios.task: Read the repository and the installed Cerebellum. Create a concise, evidence-backed Cortex for this repository. It must make a future agent able to find the transaction ownership boundary and its regression test quickly. Do not change application or test code.

Investigate whether a caller from tenant A can update a transaction owned by tenant B. Write a concise diagnosis to the result file. State yes or no, explain authorization, lookup, persistence, and the smallest safe fix. Cite repository-relative file paths.

Run the tests, fix the authorization defect without weakening or deleting tests, then rerun the tests. Keep transaction ownership immutable through this update path. Write a one-paragraph verification note to the result file.

Inspect the settlement calculation. Add one focused regression test proving that a negative adjustment reduces the settlement. Do not change production code. Run the tests and write a brief verification note to the result file.
